title: data-objectstack：上传文件和 metadata-client 绕过注入的 fetch，纯令牌会话下被当匿名（接 #37225）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding S3a of the seat's L2 on PR #37489 (#37225), record 7187820695; the seat asked the owning zone to card it under #37225. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · reach: file uploads and metadata reads through data-objectstack under a bearer-only session · evidence: L2 record 7187820695; os-dev report 7187574466.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：data-objectstack 的 uploadFile / uploadFiles 绕过了注入的 config.fetch，metadata-client 也有一处裸请求。纯令牌会话下上传和元数据读取会被当成匿名。
- 谁受益：嵌入或云租户里上传文件、读元数据的用户。
- 不做会怎样：这些操作在纯令牌会话下失败或拿到空。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`: `uploadFile` / `uploadFiles` call `fetch` directly instead of the injected `config.fetch` (2 sites).
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`: 1 bare call.

## Acceptance

- Each call goes through the injected fetch; a pin per site with a cookie-only control.

Blocked-by: #37225
